result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\. They're both excellent, but they suit slightly different priorities.

My overall recommendation is **1Password for ease of use** and **Bitwarden for best value**\.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall for ease of use)

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared team vaults.
- Granular permissions and access controls.
- Strong admin and security reporting.
- Easy onboarding for non-technical staff.

**Indicative price\:** \$24.95/month for up to 10 users on Teams Starter Pack.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value for money)

- Open-source software.
- Shared collections and team vaults.
- User management and audit logs.
- Good security and transparency.
- Self-hosting option for organisations.

**Indicative price\:** \$4/user/month for Teams, billed annually.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Security**

(Best for advanced security)

- Detailed access controls.
- Shared team folders.
- Delegated administration.
- Strong compliance and reporting options.

**Indicative price\:** From around \$4/user/month for Business.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Proton Pass Plus - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ieWxaf1V1oKwR5RRYZyCUPTssuPFmf3KGImAFxDImLo918b9HrqSkmcFxYOmTtZlPSYlBfMDN2fRfrT9cxgSPcskegAU9CMbarL_OHz9CIE3qqDdr6RF19eJVNxO2Ol4ntEKr3D7ZAQzGf8y8YfFA_bGj9p5D2RwqWU6uGCUEvGwoAX0vUa7O4BZUHkNpExF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

(Best privacy-focused option)

- End-to-end encrypted vaults.
- Secure sharing.
- Email aliases.
- Good option for teams already using Proton services.

**Indicative price\:** From around \$2/user/month.

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Dashlane**

(Best for security monitoring)

- Password health monitoring.
- Credential risk alerts.
- Business administration.
- Phishing-related protection features.

**Indicative price\:** Around \$8/user/month, depending on plan.

[Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

## My comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good |
| Shared passwords | Yes | Yes |
| Team permissions | Excellent | Very good |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Open source | No | Yes |
| Self-hosting | No | Yes |
| Value for money | Good | Excellent |


## What I'd look for in a small business

Regardless of which you choose, make sure you have\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Share company credentials without sending passwords over email or Slack.
2. **Individual accounts\:** Every employee has their own login.
3. **Access permissions\:** Staff only see passwords relevant to their role.
4. **Offboarding\:** Immediately revoke access when someone leaves.
5. **MFA\:** Require multi-factor authentication.
6. **Audit logs\:** Know who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend something that fits your actual business rather than simply the most popular product.

**1\. How many people are in your team?**
